title: Flow Proximity Connect
description: Add proximity connect to compatible channels in flow DAG.
summary: Proximity connect now enforces strict 1-to-1 channel wiring: is_valid_connection rejects sources that already have an outgoing edge (in addition to occupied targets), so dragging a wired cut node no longer previews or commits edges from already-connected sphere/torus outputs to inputs a/b. Flow neuron_io_layout sets connected metadata on variadic and input_ports fallback inputs. Added graph, dag host, and flow integration tests for wired cut drag.
